يحتوون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَوُونَ (yaḥtawūna) /jaħ.ta.wuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَوَى (iḥtawā)
# يُحْتَوَوْنَ (yuḥtawawna) /juħ.ta.waw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَوَى (iḥtawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
